job: Browse data providers, filter them and open one to try its capabilities.
purpose: A browse screen: a toolbar with search, a human or agent view and filters, then recommended, featured and all providers as cards with price, capability count and a verified mark. The agent view lists the same providers as plain rows. Filters narrow the grid, Load more reveals the rest, and a provider picker dialog accepts terms in bulk.
useWhen: A team chooses among many providers or sources by category, price and trust.
The same catalog must be readable as cards for people and as rows for an agent.

avoidWhen.when: One provider is already chosen and the person tries its capabilities.
The items are the team's own records, not offers from others.

states.name: ready
states.how: the default: recommended, featured and all providers

states.name: loading
states.how: ?state=loading: skeleton card grids under each heading

states.name: no-results
states.how: ?state=no-results: a search that matches nothing; fd-empty with Clear filters

states.name: error
states.how: ?state=error: the catalog did not load; fd-empty data-tone="danger" with Retry
